manual.measurement_scope: Self-recorded independent human review of synthetic resumes

automated.measurement_scope: Local batch extraction and rule-based screening only; excludes UI, file upload, report export, SQLite, recruiter corrections and approval.

timing_comparison.explanation: The ratio compares different measurement scopes and is not a validated end-to-end recruiter productivity gain.

limitations: Ten synthetic resumes; findings are not representative of production recruiting.
Reference expectations are not independently adjudicated ground truth.
Manual review times and decisions are self-recorded, not independently observed.
Automated timings exclude upload, UI, database writes, exports, human verification and approval.
Repeated local benchmark runs may benefit from OS caches and warm-up effects.
Evidence-note presence is not proof of evidence quality; human inspection is required.
No end-to-end time savings percentage is claimed.
